libs.note: BH-1941 (BH-1511.4, endpoints wave 1). The base URL of the Clerk Backend API, resolved by endpoint_url clerk (bin/lib/endpoints.sh). Read by bin/qa-clerk-ban.sh (the /v1/users/<id> reads and ban/unban); CLERK_API in the env still wins, as it always has. The resolver itself is bin/lib/endpoints.sh (endpoint_url builds the knob name); `file` is the consumer that names it.

knobs.note: Base URL of the Clerk Backend API; the API path stays in code. Registry default = the literal the scripts carried until BH-1941, so nothing resolves differently. settable:false (BH-1165): a URL a root lane sends a Bearer token to is set by the operator's env, never by a settings row; no row can override it. Was a literal https://api.clerk.com.
